questions.q: If 22 December 2024 was a Sunday, what day of the week was 4 March 2025?
questions.why: 72 days later; 72 mod 7 = 2, so count 2 days on from Sunday. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: What comes next in the series? 9, 11, 17, 27, 41, …
questions.why: The differences go up by 4 each time (2, 6, 10, 14, 18). Next: 59. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: If NURSING is written as IPKUTWP in a certain code, how is CLINIC written in that code?
questions.why: In the code each letter moves 2 places forward and the word is then reversed: CLINIC → EKPKNE. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Amit, Anil and Ajit ride the same distance at speeds 5 : 4 : 3, taking 94 minutes in total. How long does Anil take?
questions.why: Times are in the ratio 1/5 : 1/4 : 1/3 = 12 : 15 : 20; 94 ÷ 47 = 2, so Anil 30 min. GPSC CBRT, Apr 2024.

questions.q: In a certain code MONDAY is 6, TUESDAY is 7 and WEDNESDAY is 9. What is SATURDAY in that code?
questions.why: Each word is coded by the number of letters in it. SATURDAY has 8.

questions.q: At what percentage above cost must an article be marked to gain 8% after a 10% discount?
questions.why: 0.9 × M = 1.08 × C, so M = 1.2 × C: 20% above cost. GPSC CBRT, Dec 2023.

questions.q: If 19 October 2025 was a Sunday, what day of the week was 16 November 2025?
questions.why: 28 days later; 28 mod 7 = 0, so count 0 days on from Sunday. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a row of 42 students, Manoj is 9th from the left and Lata is 17th from the right. How many students sit between them?

Manoj covered a distance of 50 m towards the North. He then turned to his left and walked 20 m. He again turned left and walked 60 m. Finally, he turned to his right at an angle of 45°. In which direction is he moving finally?
questions.why: N, then left = W, then left = S. Turning 45° right from South points South-West. GPSC CBRT, Nov 2023.

questions.q: In a group of 110 people, 46 like chess, 70 like carrom and 35 like neither. How many like only chess?
questions.why: Both = 46 + 70 − (110 − 35) = 41; only chess = 46 − 41 = 5. GPSC-style practice item.
